title: CSR Building Products Limited - proposed acquisition of Burnbridge Glass Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: CSR Limited proposed to acquire Burnbridge Glass Pty Ltd.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of a market for the manufacture and supply of processed glass products. While the ACCC did not form a concluded view in relation to the relevant geographic scope of this market, it considered the likely impact of the proposed acquisition in the greater Sydney and central NSW coast region (including the areas of Newcastle, the NSW Central Coast and Port Macquarie).
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC concluded that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant market. In forming this view the ACCC had regard to the following factors: - that post acquisition, a number of other substantial manufacturers of processed glass will remain in the relevant market (including several existing and potential suppliers from outside of Newcastle), thereby constraining the merged entity's ability to increase product prices or reduce service quality; and - that barriers to entry do not appear to be high.
